QuestionStmt.S: The three vectors $\vec{A} = 3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}$, $\vec{B} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$ and $\vec{C} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$ will form

Solution.S:
Magnitudes: $|\vec{A}| = \sqrt{14}$, $|\vec{B}| = \sqrt{35}$, $|\vec{C}| = \sqrt{21}$.

No two sides are equal, so not isosceles or equilateral.

Dot products: $\vec{A}\cdot\vec{B} = 14$, $\vec{B}\cdot\vec{C} = 25$, $\vec{A}\cdot\vec{C} = 12$.

None are zero, so not right-angled.

Scalar triple product:

$$[\vec{A}\,\vec{B}\,\vec{C}] = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & -2 & 1 \\ 1 & -3 & 5 \\ 2 & -1 & 4 \end{vmatrix} = -28 \neq 0$$

So the vectors are not coplanar and do not form a triangle. Hence the correct option is C: no triangle.
